scope: Active English Gold72 and Chinese Hard66 forms; no canonical edits and no replacement questions generated.
validation_repairs: Accept joined complete MCQ option quotations only when each quoted option matches displayed text verbatim and any supplied label matches its option. Reject paraphrases, ellipses, and mismatched labels.

When no intended_target is supplied, normalize an erroneous explicit target_basis label to inferred. Preserve the raw label, target text, uncertainty and every substantive score/verdict. Whether an explicit design target was supplied is determined by the input.
Retry invalid structured outputs using the same prompts, payloads and model, preserving rejected responses under responses/invalid. Reuse valid cached stages.
caution: Stable model judgments are not independently verified human difficulty labels. Content holds arising from short passage windows need contextual adjudication.
